;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 London Bridge stabbing]]
**A [[terrorism in the United Kingdom|terrorist]] [[mass stabbing]] at [[London Bridge]] kills two [[civilian]]s and injures three others. The attacker, [[Usman Khan (terrorist)|Usman Khan]], wearing a fake [[explosive belt]], is shot dead by [[Metropolitan Police|police]] on the bridge. Khan was a former prisoner convicted of terrorism offences, and had links to [[Islamist terrorist]] groups. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-50610215 (BBC News)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**After a surprise visit by [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], the [[Taliban]] say they are ready to restart [[Afghan peace process|peace talks]] and reach a [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-afghanistan-taliban/after-trumps-kabul-visit-taliban-says-ready-to-resume-peace-talks-idUSKBN1Y30GR (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Iraqi protests]]
**Protests continue across [[Iraq]] with a death toll of seven protesters by unsourced reports. Other reports by hospital sources state the death toll is over 20 due to [[Iraqi Armed Forces|Iraqi forces]] opening fire in [[Nasiriya]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/protesters-shot-dead-violence-continues-iraq-191129193729541.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50600495 (BBC News)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[Houthi movement|Houthi militants]] say that they shot down a [[Saudi Arabia]]n [[helicopter]], killing both pilots. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed the incident. [https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201911291077435287-houthi-forces-claim-theyve-shot-down-a-saudi-helicopter/ (Sputnik)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**It is expected that there will be 70 deaths from the illness, and at least 6,500 people will be infected by the highly infectious disease. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=12289525 (''NZ Herald'')]
;Law and crime
*The [[government of Sudan]] repeals all laws [[gender inequality in Sudan|restricting]] women's freedom of dress, movement, association, work and study, and dissolves the former ruling party. [[List of heads of government of Sudan|Sudanese Prime Minister]] [[Abdalla Hamdok]] praises women on [[social media]] and says that the laws were “an instrument of exploitation, humiliation, violation, aggression on the rights of citizens”. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/29/sudan-dissolves-ex-ruling-party-and-repeals-morality-law (''The Guardian'')]
*A [[Suriname|national]] court rules [[President of Suriname]] [[Dési Bouterse]] guilty of murder. The case addresses the execution of 15 government critics in 1982, following the [[1980 Surinamese coup d'état|1980 Sergeants' Coup]] led by Bouterse. Six other former military officers are also declared guilty. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/30/suriname-president-guilty-of-over-1982-executions (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Law enforcement in the Netherlands|Police]] report that three young people have been wounded in a stabbing on a shopping street in [[The Hague]], [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-netherlands-stabbing/dutch-police-several-wounded-in-stabbing-in-the-hague-idUSKBN1Y329Y (Reuters)]
*[[Burning Sun scandal]]
**[[K-pop]] [[singer-songwriter]] [[Jung Joon-young]] receives a six-year prison term and former [[boy band]] member [[Choi Jong-hoon]] is sentenced to a five-year term for having sex with a woman who was unable to consent, as well as other [[sex crime]]s including filming women without consent. [https://apnews.com/23b91b670a8d4e83b9ca62db8bff2b03 (AP)]

**[[Prime Minister of Iraq]] [[Adel Abdul Mahdi]] announces plans to offer his resignation to the [[Iraq|country]]'s [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|parliament]] as a reaction to the ongoing protest movement. [https://www.dw.com/en/iraq-prime-minister-adel-abdul-mahdi-says-he-will-resign/a-51469003 (DW)]
*[[Prime Minister of Malta]] [[Joseph Muscat]] intends to step down following controversy over an ongoing investigation about the murder of [[Investigative journalism|investigative journalist]] [[Daphne Caruana Galizia]] two years ago. [https://www.dw.com/en/maltas-prime-minister-joseph-muscat-to-resign/a-51471942 (DW)]
*Former [[Japan]]ese [[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Yasuhiro Nakasone]] dies at the [[centenarian|age of 101]]. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20191129_37/amp.html (NHK WORLD News)]
